svg.aria-label: Sequence of one Strobe Assistant chat turn showing sign-in, ACP authenticate, MCP bearer calls and the three verification points
svg.title: One chat turn — the token's journey, step by step
svg.text: One chat turn — the token's journey, step by step
Sign in once at the A1 API, prove identity once per WebSocket at ACP authenticate, then carry the same token on every MCP call. Each service re-verifies it.
or authRequired: "Invalid or expired sign-in token."
no identity, or exp passed → authRequired
invalid → HTTP 401, no tool code runs
agent-only tool, hidden from the model
— the tool has no userId argument at all
injected by the server, unseen by the model
enrich text hits · same Bearer → V1 authorizer
only this user's hits · URLs → strobe:// refs
Source: acp_client/web/main.ts · agent/src/agent.ts, auth.ts, mcp.ts · fastmcp_http_server.py
